_readme: Explicit sentence-bound repairs. Replay: node scripts/realbank/repair_repeat_scenes.mjs --write
cross_source requires unchanged target/donor texts and the same donor frame metadata. No fuzzy matching at replay.
Only missing sentence frames are added; existing frames and all other item fields are preserved.
Original source assets are tracked under public/real-bank/speaking/recovered. SHA1 is checked before every dry/write replay.
frame_kind=unhighlighted_scene_shared_by_sentences means the same original static scene is scoped to those sentences, not a per-sentence highlight. No mixed-item base is assigned.
